items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: So he sat down in my seat and we ya-ya'd all the way back, with Taubman and Artie Baker and some more of them.

ctx.x: Well, he was riding first class, but we held up the plane in Paris for an hour making this connection from Rabat to Paris -- they held up the plane coming to New York for an hour. So he came back and said, 'I want to see who held up my trip an hour.' And we've got on African safari hats and safari jackets and sunburn and husky -- you know, three months

in the bush and you show it. Some guys had fez on. He said, 'What is this back here?' 'Well, we are the Great American Band.' 'Musicians?' 'Yeah.' So he sat down in my seat and we ya-ya'd all the way back, with Taubman and Artie Baker and some more of them. We had an incident the first night in Senegal. We had a trumpet player with us. He was a Jewish boy but a great trumpet player. You've heard him on the Jackie Gleason program many, many times. Anyhow, he got out of the cab one night and -- in Senegal in Dakar,…
But all in all it was a successful trip?
